main.description: A time-boxed CBDB event (e.g. a city's Burger Week). Authored and owned by CBDB, stored on CBDB's own PDS — the canonical source of truth for the event's dates and participating restaurants. auth-proxy.js reads this record to tag reviews at write time instead of holding its own copy of the restaurant list.

slug.description: Short event tag ID stamped on reviews, e.g. 'PDXBW26'. Also the record's rkey.

host.description: Organizing publication or entity, e.g. 'Portland Mercury'.

hostUrl.description: Link to the host's own event page.

restaurants.description: Participating restaurant names. Matching is case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed, against the `restaurant` field on a review.

badgeThreshold.description: Number of event-tagged reviews needed to earn the badge.

championThreshold.description: Number of event-tagged reviews needed to earn the champion tier.

winnerThreshold.description: Number of event-tagged reviews needed to earn the winner tier. Deliberately rare — designed to exceed the number of days in the event window.

badgeDefinition.description: AT-URI of the community.lexicon.badge.definition record for this event's badge tier.

championDefinition.description: AT-URI of the community.lexicon.badge.definition record for this event's champion tier.

winnerDefinition.description: AT-URI of the community.lexicon.badge.definition record for this event's winner tier.

calendarEvent.description: Optional. AT-URI of a community.lexicon.calendar.event record for this event, for discoverability in ATProto calendar apps.
